title: NEON breeding landbird point counts, RELEASE-2026: individuals of 283 species per 6-minute count at 3434 points across 47 NEON sites, 2013-2024
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Breeding landbird point counts (DP1.10003.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/v6hs-mx57. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.10003.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-02
abstract: NEON's breeding landbird survey: 6-minute point counts, once or twice per breeding season, at grids of nine points (large sites) or single points (small sites) on every NEON terrestrial site, with every individual recorded by minute, distance, detection method and cluster. This table aggregates the per-detection records to the number of individuals of each species per count for the 283 species with at least 100 detected clusters over the release; every shipped species carries a row at every count. Unit coordinates are the point coordinates NEON publishes. Sibling table neon_2026_landbirds_ds holds the same counts as distance-bin cells.
samplingProtocol: 6-minute unlimited-radius point counts between dawn and 3.5 h after sunrise, May-July, by trained observers; each individual or cluster recorded with minute of first detection, radial distance (laser rangefinder), detection method and cluster size; one or two bouts per year (NEON TOS protocol for breeding landbird sampling)
surveyEvidenceNote: brd_perpoint lists every point-count event; a count exists iff samplingImpractical == OK and at least one brd_countdata row (a targetTaxaPresent = N row records a count with no detections). Species pool is national: every shipped species at every count.
closureNote: occasion = bout within the breeding season (1-2 counts per point per year); period = calendar year
geographicCoverage: 47 NEON terrestrial sites in 20 domains, continental USA, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico; point coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 18.0 to 71.3, longitude -156.6 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (agency-published point coordinates); no coarsening. Species of concern are already reported by NEON at a higher taxonomic rank ('fuzzed') or withheld at some sites, and those records are not shipped

components.neon_2026_landbirds_ds: the same counts as distance-bin cells (multinomial_cell, four bins) for the species with >= 2000 clusters

covariateNote: obs_air_temp_c, obs_wind_kmh, obs_cloud_pct (start of count), obs_rh_pct (start) and obs_habitat are the observer's field records per count; end-of-count cloud and RH are not carried. Point-level facts (site, domain, NEON namedLocation, plot type, NLCD class, coordinates, coordinate uncertainty, elevation) are in __units; the core carries unit_site only, to keep an 8-figure table narrow. NEON publishes the grid centre for the nine points of a bird grid (coordinateUncertaintyInMeters ~250 m), so points of one grid share coordinates; single-point arrays carry the point itself.
notes: Taxa: the 283 species-rank taxa with >= 100 clusters; 261 species below the cut are listed in notShipped. Clusters: records sharing a clusterCode within a count and species are one cluster counted once (first minute). 6 duplicated perpoint rows and 0 point-year-bouts counted twice keep the first record; 5 counts whose countdata start time differs from the perpoint start time are re-keyed by point and day; 897 detection records at PUUM with no clusterSize count one individual each. Period = calendar year, so a point surveyed in one bout only has one occasion that year.
